title: record_transaction tool input (LLM output, strict)
description: Input of the record_transaction tool. The LLM never sends amount_rial. Backend computes it. Every key required; nulls allowed where stated.

type.description: One of the 14 template ids minus REVERSAL. null only when needs_clarification is set.

amount_text.description: Amount phrase copied verbatim from the user text (e.g. "۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان"). Null only when needs_clarification is set.

amount_value.description: Number as stated in the text, integer, no arithmetic. Persian/Arabic digits converted to ASCII.

amount_unit.description: toman (default when no unit is stated) or rial.

paid_with.description: CASH, BANK, or null for credit (نسیه).

party_name.description: Counterparty name without honorifics, or null.

category.description: Only for EXPENSE_PAID and EXPENSE_PAYABLE; null otherwise.

needs_clarification.description: Short Persian question when the text is not a clear transaction. Non-null means no other field is used.
